page.overview:
Who is Gorus?

Gorus looks like Goku, but with purple skin and Beerus' cat ears. Like all EX-Fusions, his clothing is a mixture of that worn by both fusees.

Gorus is likely to be extremely strong, as he is a fusion of a God of Destruction and a Saiyan who has reached and surpassed divine levels of strength. It is also likely that Gorus would be able to utilize Ultra Instinct in some capacity, as both Goku and Beerus have utilized the state, though Beerus has not mastered it yet.

In Dragon Ball Fusions, Gorus can only be unlocked via QR Code which is only available for the original Japanese version thus Gorus is unavailable in the English localization.
